## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals with Technology and Materials showing strength while Financials and Healthcare lag; leadership concentration tilted to Technology (3/5 of top performers).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.03% | 1M: +20.26%). Technology strong: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%). Energy resilient: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +15.51%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +13.27%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare weak: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -15.45% | 1M: -11.39%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -5.01%). Financials lag: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.42% | 1M: -7.86%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -9.91%). Industrials showing exhaustion: GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.08%), CAT in CORRECTION (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +10.60%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -1.25%), GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.04%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology-tilt).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -15.45% | 1M: -11.39%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -14.62%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -10.08% | 1M: +34.75%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -6.24%), GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.08%). Weakness concentrated in large-cap Healthcare and select Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: TXN (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), NEM (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%), META (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%), MSFT (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -1.25%), GILD (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.04%). Major divergence present: MSFT and AAPL showing 1W strength vs 1M weakness and INTC the opposite; treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive. NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +0.52%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +7.18%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +3.55% | 1M: -6.20%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -1.25%); sector-level returns positive (1W: +2.38% | 1M: +0.30%) with notable internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft and uneven. JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.42% | 1M: -7.86%), V RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -7.89%), COF BELOW TREND (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -12.40%); financials are a drag on breadth (sector 1W: -0.32% | 1M: -3.77%).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautionary; leadership bifurcated. JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +9.68%) and PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +4.80%) contrast with UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -15.45% | 1M: -11.39%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -14.62%); sector 1W: -2.74% | 1M: -0.93%.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to Materials and Energy names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND (NEM, FCX, XOM, CVX) and monitor Technology RECOVERY names (MSFT, AAPL) for follow-through; reduce exposure to large Healthcare laggards (UNH, ABT) and weak Financials (JPM, COF). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given tech tilt but breadth only 5/11.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +0.52%) — watch follow-through on earnings/supply catalysts. BEARISH: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -15.45% | 1M: -11.39%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -14.62%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -10.08% | 1M: +34.75%) — monitor further downside or capitulation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +2.47% | 1M: +12.69%) and Energy (1W: +1.73% | 1M: +14.13%) on commodity and macro flows. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -2.74% | 1M: -0.93%) and Financials (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -3.77%) where earnings/credit headlines could extend weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA resistance near recent high (watch whether ABOVE TREND continuation holds), AAPL support near short-term base (AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +3.55% | 1M: -6.20%)), MSFT needs 1M trend confirmation to shift RECOVERY into ABOVE TREND, UNH downside pivot to confirm further weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
META (+75): "Major AI acceleration" headline; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%) — sentiment confirmed. NVDA (+75): China H200 approval headline; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +0.52%) — confirming accumulation. MDT (+70): CE mark news; use MDT ABOVE TREND if confirmed (monitor price action).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ABT (-60): earnings-related selloff; price BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -14.62%) — sentiment confirmed. PFE (-50): Eliquis concern; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +4.80%) — divergence, monitor. ADBE (-50): acquisition headline negative; check price for confirmation (watch for distribution).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%) showing strength. Major divergence among large caps (MSFT, AAPL, INTC) and mixed sentiment on key names (ABT, PFE) requires monitoring before committing to a directional shift.
